title: Cells of the inner separator
statement: Let $bs$, $\alpha$, and $x$ be finite Boolean words. For every $r<4$, the entry at index $4|bs|+r$ of the nested pair encoding $\langle\langle bs,\alpha\rangle,x\rangle$ equals the entry at index $r$ of the four-bit word $0011$.
hypotheses_covered: Three arbitrary finite Boolean words $bs$, $\alpha$, and $x$
replaced:
For every $r < 4$, cell $4|b| + r$ of the nested pair encoding
$\langle \langle b, \alpha\rangle, x\rangle$ holds the $r$-th symbol of the
four-cell separator $0011$.
